question.text: If \(A=\left(\begin{array}{cc}3 & x-1 \\ 2 x+3 & x+2\end{array}\right)\) is a symmetric matrix, then the value of \(x\) is

solution.text:
Hints: \(A=A^T\)
\(\begin{aligned}
& \left(\begin{array}{cc}
3 & x-1 \\
2 x+3 & x+2
\end{array}\right)=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
3 & 2 x+3 \\
x-1 & x+2
\end{array}\right) \\
& \Rightarrow x-1=2 x+3 \text { or } x=-4
\end{aligned}\)
